integrity: All search bounds are proved symbolically. The packaged verifier uses only integer arithmetic and a deterministic sieve, enumerates every admissible prime pair in the proved finite ranges, and directly checks the unique filling identity.
scientific limitations: The result classifies only four-prime fillings of H=(113322,797) whose least prime is 157. It does not classify four-prime fillings with another least prime or solve the six-prime filling problem.
title: Uniqueness of the four-prime port filling with least prime 157
